triage.note: Work top-down. Do NOT hand P3 to the same session as P0/P1. Severity is likelihood x impact, not only risk type: RIT-GEN-005/006 are High but their impact is UX/persistence with low data-loss risk (fix early because small and safe, not because they are the same risk class as RIT-GEN-001/002/004).
triage.shared_root_cause: Most P0-P2 findings are the same class: async callback lifecycle with shared Cancellables and strong Rc captures across workspace/editor_tab/source_control. A unified cancellable-slot + weak-capture strategy addresses RIT-GEN-004/007/008/010/011/019 more durably than point fixes.

findings.title: Raw filenames sent as glob-interpreting Git pathspecs in stage/unstage/discard
findings.summary: git_env() lacks GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS, so restore/ls-tree/update-index treat filenames with [, *, ?, : as glob/magic; discard reverts sibling files and unstage deletes the index entry for the named file. Correction (2026-07-06, remediation, verified on git 2.54.0): the unstage sub-claim is refuted - ls-tree matches the literal filename and does not wildmatch, so unstage_path never reaches the force-remove branch and unstage is already correct; the discard claim is confirmed (restore --worktree reverts glob-matched siblings without the env var). Fix and Critical severity unchanged.
findings.reproduction: Repo with tracked+modified+staged 'pages/[id].tsx' and a sibling 'pages/i.tsx' with unstaged edits; press Unstage or Discard in Source Control; git restore/update-index hit the wrong files.
findings.suggested_fix: Add ("GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS", "1") to git_env() in support.rs; update build-aux/git/README.md contract note.
findings.suggested_test: git_process/tests.rs temp repo with '[id].txt' + 'i.txt': assert unstage keeps '[id].txt' staged-modified (not deleted) and 'i.txt' untouched; assert restore_worktree_path('[id].txt') preserves 'i.txt' edits.

findings.title: Stale File-Changed-on-Disk banner Reload discards typed edits and clears undo
findings.summary: Banner Reload routes to request_reload(_, _, false) -> ReloadCause::UserRequested, which has no is_dirty() guard (Automatic does); banner is not re-synced on keystrokes, so edits typed after the banner appears are replaced and undo is emptied.
findings.reproduction: Open file, keep focused+selected, modify externally to show Reload banner, type text, click Reload -> buffer replaced, Ctrl+Z restores nothing.
findings.suggested_fix: In on_banner_action, when tab.is_dirty() present dialogs::confirm_external_reload instead of request_reload; re-sync/hide banner on dirty transition.
findings.suggested_test: GTK test: inject external change, show banner, type text, trigger banner action, assert buffer retains typed text.

findings.title: Compare/review uses a different line tokenizer than the diff model (lone CR)
findings.summary: Model side uses text.tokenize_lines() (splits on lone \r); display side uses split_inclusive('\n'). Row indices from the model index the other slicing, so files with a lone CR render changed lines as context and tags land on wrong buffer lines.
findings.reproduction: Open file with 'a\rb\nX\n', change X to Y, Compare with Saved Version; changed line rendered as context.
findings.suggested_fix: Share the diff.rs tokenize_lines helper into controller.rs/review_session.rs and strip/escape interior \r (and U+2028/2029) when building buffer text.
findings.suggested_test: Unit test display_for_model text for CR input; buffer test buffer.line_count() == display.rows.len().

findings.title: Rc reference cycles leak the per-window Workspace; leaked Git monitors keep running after close
findings.summary: sidebar_wiring uses strong Rc::clone captures in handlers stored in OnceCell/state, forming Workspace->handler->WindowGitActions->Workspace and a source-control self-cycle; leaked SourceControlState keeps gio::FileMonitor callbacks running git subprocesses after window close. document_tools.rs/window_compare.rs use the correct weak pattern.
findings.reproduction: Static: enumerate the two cycles. Runtime: build window, hold Weak<Workspace>, close, assert weak still upgrades.
findings.suggested_fix: Capture Rc::downgrade(&git_actions) and a weak of the source-control state; upgrade inside the closures (as document_tools.rs/window_compare.rs do).
findings.suggested_test: DialogLeakCanary-style GTK test: build+destroy window, assert Weak<Workspace> and source-control weak no longer upgrade.

findings.severity_note: High on likelihood x impact, but impact type is UX/persistence with low data-loss risk; fix early (small, safe) but do not treat as the same risk class as RIT-GEN-001/002/004. Triage: P1.
findings.title: Window size persisted only via the dirty-close dialog path
findings.summary: persist_window_size runs only when allow_window_close() is true, which is set only in finish_window_close (dirty flow); a clean close returns Proceed without persisting, so window-width/height never update in the common case.
findings.reproduction: Resize a clean window, close it; window-width/height GSettings keys do not update.
findings.suggested_fix: Persist window size before any proceeding close in on_close_request (set_window_size is sanitized and cheap).
findings.suggested_test: Memory-backend GTK test: resize clean window, close, assert write_log_for_tests contains window-width write.

findings.severity_note: High on likelihood x impact, but impact type is UX/persistence + policy with low data-loss risk; fix early (small, safe) but do not treat as the same risk class as RIT-GEN-001/002/004. Triage: P1.
findings.title: project-sidebar-visible clobbered to false during window construction (plus startup GSettings write)
findings.summary: At construction (root None) sync_actions_for_root calls set_sidebar_visibility(false) -> persist_sidebar_visible(false), writing the key to false before the async restore reads it, so the sidebar never restores and the preference is destroyed at startup.
findings.reproduction: Set project-folder-uri + project-sidebar-visible=true, build window, wait for restore; sidebar stays hidden and the key was written before restore.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the no-root sync non-persisting so it collapses the pane and syncs action state without persist_sidebar_visible; persist only on user toggle and root open/close.
findings.suggested_test: Memory-settings GTK test: assert project_sidebar_visible_for_tests() is true after restore and no project-sidebar-visible write occurred before restore.

findings.title: Git timeout grace window is dead code; mutating children SIGKILLed immediately
findings.summary: On timeout, cancellable.cancel() makes communicate_async return Cancelled immediately; the callback cancels the grace source and, because timed_out is true, kills at once even for MUTATING_KILL_ON_CANCEL=false ops, so a timed-out mutation can strand .git/index.lock. Not addressed by batch-2 Task 3.
findings.reproduction: Static trace. Runtime: a git wrapper sleeping >30s shows immediate SIGKILL after cancel, not +2s grace.
findings.suggested_fix: When timed_out && !kill_on_cancel, keep the grace source alive and let it fire (or SIGTERM then SIGKILL after grace); keep wait_async reaping.
findings.suggested_test: Harness test with a stub-slow git asserting kill happens no earlier than GIT_CANCEL_KILL_GRACE for a kill_on_cancel=false spec.

findings.title: No index-lock gate for actions: overlapping mutation fails with generic error
findings.summary: begin_action_inner cancels the previous cancellable and starts immediately; a cancelled mutating child keeps running and holds .git/index.lock, so a quickly-following stage fails with 'The Git operation failed.' Refresh has a lock gate; actions do not.
findings.reproduction: Repo where update-index takes >~100ms; click Stage on two rows quickly.
findings.suggested_fix: In begin_action_inner, if index_lock_exists or a mutation is in flight, queue/deny with the existing waiting message instead of firing concurrently.
findings.suggested_test: Unit test a begin_action gate with a stubbed lock probe.

findings.title: Review tab renders Git paths without display escaping (line-map desync + bidi spoof)
findings.summary: path_display embeds the raw path instead of using escape_git_path_display; a filename with \n yields two buffer lines for one rendered_lines entry, shifting navigation/open targets, and C0/bidi controls render unescaped.
findings.reproduction: Repo with a modified tracked file named 'a\nb.txt'; open Review Unstaged Changes; navigation targets after the boundary are off by one.
findings.suggested_fix: Route path_display (and DisplayFileBoundaryRow.path) through escape_git_path_display.
findings.suggested_test: Review-session unit test with a \n path asserting render_text().lines().count() == rendered_lines.len().

findings.title: Opening a row Diff cancels an in-flight status refresh that is never rescheduled
findings.summary: begin_action_inner (shared by non-mutating Diff) cancels state.cancellable which during a Manual/Initial refresh is the refresh's cancellable; nothing reschedules, so the label sticks at 'Refreshing Git status...' and commit stays disabled.
findings.reproduction: Press Refresh on a large repo, immediately single-click a row (activates Diff); UI stuck refreshing.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a separate cancellable slot for diff blob loads, or reschedule via live::schedule after cancel.
findings.suggested_test: Controller test: start manual refresh with stubbed slow status, run Diff, assert a refresh re-issues / label recovers.

findings.title: Overlapping open hijacks a still-loading clean-untitled tab; first file dropped silently
findings.summary: is_clean_untitled ignores is_loading, so acquire_open_target reuses a tab currently loading file A for file B; B cancels A's IO, A's completion fails Cancelled and is swallowed, so A never opens and no error is shown.
findings.reproduction: One empty tab; open slow file A then immediately file B; only B opens, no error.
findings.suggested_fix: In acquire_open_target, refuse reuse when the candidate tab is a registered pending-open target or is_loading().
findings.suggested_test: GTK test: open A then B in the same main-loop turn; assert tab_count == 2 and both URIs present.

findings.title: Cursor movement re-spawns git cat-file per UI idle for a clean git-modified file
findings.summary: refresh_tab_without_cancel loads the reference blob (git cat-file, up to 1MB) before the already_current dedupe check, which lives inside apply_source_control_minimap_diff; every cursor-move idle spawns/kills a subprocess.
findings.reproduction: Open a modified file in a git repo, move the cursor repeatedly; observe repeated git cat-file spawns.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a pre-spawn predicate checking state.ui.minimap_diff.applied.source == source && !stale before load_reference_blob.
findings.suggested_test: Test-only spawn counter in GitProcess::run; apply diff, move cursor N times, assert counter did not grow.

findings.title: CRLF normalization turns every \r\n into a blank line
findings.summary:
normalize_markdown_character maps '' -> '
' per character, so 
 becomes 

; CRLF Markdown is double-spaced and soft breaks become paragraph breaks. Live path mitigated by GtkSourceView load normalization; fuzz/paste paths affected.
findings.reproduction: parse_document("a\r\nb") yields two paragraphs instead of one with a SoftBreak.
findings.suggested_fix:
Collapse 
 to 
 before the per-char map (or drop the ->
 rewrite and let pulldown-cmark handle line endings); keep control-char/U+FFFD to space.
findings.suggested_test: parse_document("Line 1\r\nLine 2") produces one paragraph with a SoftBreak; render test asserting no double-spacing.

findings.title: decode_page_window is an untrusted-byte boundary with no fuzz target or registry entry
findings.summary: decode_page_window does raw-slice UTF-8 trimming and from_utf8_lossy on arbitrary file bytes at arbitrary offsets, but is not in any fuzz target or the parser-boundary registry (large_file_paged_reader lists only reader.rs); no reachable panic today but no fuzz backstop, violating the stress-fuzz policy's boundary-mapping requirement.
findings.reproduction: page_text.rs appears in neither app/fuzz/fuzz_targets nor the registry source_paths/coverage.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a fuzz_page_decode shim + page_text_decode fuzz target with a seed; add page_text.rs to the registry source_paths + coverage + PARSER-BOUNDARY marker.
findings.suggested_test: proptest asserting visible_start <= visible_end, next_offset > offset when non-empty, never panics.

findings.title: dependency_preflight only validates static.crates.io entries in cargo-sources.json
findings.summary: The archives comprehension pre-filters with _is_static_crates_io_archive, so non-crates.io archives, git/file entries, and inline entries other than .cargo-checksum.json are never checksum-validated or flagged stale, yet flatpak-builder materializes them before the signed offline build. Current file is clean.
findings.reproduction: rg static.crates.io tools/ shows the only URL constraint; no other tool reads cargo-sources.json.
findings.suggested_fix: Make _check_cargo_sources an exact allowlist over all entries; unknown shape => hard fail.
findings.suggested_test: tools/tests case: cargo-sources list with a non-crates.io archive and an inline config.toml at .cargo -> both error.

findings.title: Release-gating CI jobs run in floating-tag container images with no enforcement
findings.summary: native-tests/flatpak-tests/flatpak run in fedora:42 and ghcr.io/flathub-infra/flatpak-github-actions:gnome-50 (floating tags); policy forbids unpinned mutable inputs but _check_mutable_inputs never inspects container images. These contexts gate signing.
findings.reproduction: rg docker|container|image|@sha256|ghcr tools/ matches only an unrelated check.
findings.suggested_fix: Digest-pin both images and extend _check_mutable_inputs to flag image:/docker pull without @sha256.
findings.suggested_test: tools/tests workflow fixture: image: foo:latest -> error; image: foo@sha256:<64hex> -> pass.

findings.title: Rollback/same-version gate binds CANDIDATE_REF to GITHUB_REF_NAME not release_ref
findings.summary: version/tag_commit derive from release_ref but the monotonic/rollback gate gets CANDIDATE_REF=GITHUB_REF_NAME; a dispatch rollback documents the wrong ref (main) and an idempotent same-version republish from main wrongly fails.
findings.reproduction: Static trace of the publish preflight.
findings.suggested_fix: Set CANDIDATE_REF="$release_ref" (one line; push-tag path unchanged).
findings.suggested_test: Static token check in _check_rollback_gate for candidate_ref=$release_ref, or a workflow fixture test.

findings.title: Four release-policy keys implemented in the workflow but not machine-enforced
findings.summary: tag-ancestor-of-main, AppStream-top-release-matches-tag, signing-key private-import hygiene, and github-hosted-runner-required are implemented in publish-flatpak.yml but no tool asserts them, so a workflow edit that regresses them passes policy_check --strict.
findings.reproduction: rg is-ancestor|merge-base tools/ (only integration_preflight), rg metainfo|releases release*.py (none), rg GNUPGHOME|gpg-agent|mktemp|kill tools/ (none), rg runs-on tools/ (only fixtures).
findings.suggested_fix: Add token-presence checks in release.py/release_workflow.py for each implemented guard.
findings.suggested_test: For each: a tools/tests fixture with the guard lines removed -> expect an error.

findings.title: commit() overwrites the shared cancellable without cancelling the in-flight refresh
findings.summary: commit sets state.cancellable without previous.cancel(); during an Automatic refresh both run, a pre-commit snapshot can apply after commit's refresh (no generation guard), and commit controls can briefly re-enable allowing a second concurrent commit.
findings.reproduction: Automatic refresh coinciding with a Commit click.
findings.suggested_fix: Mirror begin_action_inner: cancel previous cancellable and set status_stale=true at commit start.
findings.suggested_test: Controller test starting refresh + commit asserting one active cancellable.

findings.title: Ignore-whitespace drops a trailing whitespace-only line without newline
findings.summary: trim_line_sides_text collapses a trailing whitespace-only unterminated line to empty, so tokenize_lines yields one fewer line and build_row_model omits the last original line from the compare view.
findings.reproduction: Compare 'a\n   ' vs 'a\nb' in ignore-whitespace mode; last line missing.
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve line count in trim_line_sides_text (emit a bare \n placeholder) or map ops back to original indices.
findings.suggested_test: Diff unit test asserting row count matches the original for a trailing whitespace-only line.

findings.title: Review loader reads whole worktree files before the aggregate cap
findings.summary: Unstaged-review worktree path loads the entire file via GIO before AGGREGATE_DECODED_BYTE_CAP is consulted; a multi-GB modified file causes a transient full-size allocation (blob reads are capped, worktree reads are not).
findings.reproduction: Review a repo with a multi-GB modified tracked file.
findings.suggested_fix: query_info_async for size first and skip beyond a per-file cap consistent with BLOB_CAP.
findings.suggested_test: Loader test with an over-cap worktree file asserting early skip without full read.

findings.title: Pending-open registry cleaned by URI only; can serve a detached tab
findings.summary: clear_pending_open matches on URI not (URI, tab); reopening a just-closed still-loading file can return the detached tab (set_selected_page on a removed page -> GTK criticals), and a successor entry for the same URI is stripped by the cancelled callback.
findings.reproduction: Open big file A, close its tab while loading, reopen A within the same main-loop breath.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass the owning tab into clear_pending_open and retain unless URI+tab match (Weak::ptr_eq); skip detached pending entries in find_tab_by_file.
findings.suggested_test: GTK test: open large fixture, close_selected_page, immediately reopen; assert attached selected tab.

findings.title: project-sidebar-visible action commits true with no project root (Ctrl+Shift+F)
findings.summary: connect_change_state sets state before validating root; open_project_search (Ctrl+Shift+F) calls set_sidebar_visible(true) unconditionally, so with no folder the action state becomes true while nothing shows and the header toggle renders checked-but-insensitive.
findings.reproduction: With no root, trigger Ctrl+Shift+F.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate root before action.set_state, or reset state to false in the early-return branch.
findings.suggested_test: With no root, change_state(true); assert action state remains false.

findings.title: EditorZoomController adds a display CssProvider per window and never removes it
findings.summary: install_provider adds a per-window provider with style_context_add_provider_for_display but has no Drop impl removing it, unlike AppChromeController; every closed window leaves a dead provider on the display for process lifetime.
findings.reproduction: Open and close a window; the provider remains attached.
findings.suggested_fix: Add impl Drop for EditorZoomController that calls style_context_remove_provider_for_display.
findings.suggested_test: Doc comment + code-review guard, or count providers via a test hook.

findings.title: Encoding chooser dialog omits the header bar used by other custom dialogs
findings.summary: present_encoding_dialog builds adw::Dialog directly without AdwToolbarView/AdwHeaderBar, so the title is a11y-only and there is no close button, unlike Recent Files which uses build_dialog_shell.
findings.reproduction: Open the encoding chooser; no header bar / close button.
findings.suggested_fix: Route the encoding dialog through build_dialog_shell.
findings.suggested_test: Assert the dialog contains a toolbar view; keep the leak-canary wiring.

findings.title: connect_changed recomputes presentation and dirty state 2-3x per keystroke
findings.summary: connect_changed calls sync_presentation() (rebuilds title/subtitle with pgettext + HOME lookup) on every change, and the visual callback synchronously rebuilds dirty_session_uris; the same work fires 2-3x per keystroke though dirty transitions are already covered by connect_modified_changed. Batch-2 Task 1/2 cover the dirty-notify and set_active_uri halves; the sync_presentation half is not covered.
findings.reproduction: Steady-state typing recomputes title/subtitle/dirty set repeatedly.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop sync_presentation + the dirty notification from connect_changed; rely on connect_modified_changed and the coalesced idle refresh.
findings.suggested_test: Extend the v13 status-coalescing GTK flow to count set_dirty_uris calls per synthetic keystroke burst.

findings.title: Large-file search clones the accumulated match vector per 256KB chunk
findings.summary: search_next is a self-recursing async scan captured in an Rc<dyn Fn>, so matches (up to 10000 x u64) and carry are cloned on every chunk callback; a multi-GB file is tens of thousands of chunks -> O(chunks x matches) memcpy.
findings.reproduction: Search a multi-GB file in the viewer.
findings.suggested_fix: Hold matches/carry in one Rc<RefCell<SearchState>> shared across the recursion.
findings.suggested_test: Existing cross-chunk tests cover behavior; optionally add an allocation counter.

findings.title: Publish build job checks out the tag name, not the validated commit SHA (TOCTOU)
findings.summary: Preflight verifies check runs against tag_commit but the build re-resolves the tag name; if the tag moves between jobs the signed artifact is built from an unvalidated commit. Mitigated by the Protect version tags ruleset (which can be disabled by the owner).
findings.reproduction: Static: build checks out release_ref, not tag_commit.
findings.suggested_fix: ref: needs.preflight.outputs.tag_commit and update _build_checkout_targets_release_ref.
findings.suggested_test: tools/tests fixture requiring tag_commit checkout.

findings.title: Test-only surfaces compiled into production builds (not cfg(test)-gated)
findings.summary: AppSettings::new_for_tests is not cfg(test)-gated and drags the whole in-memory backend (Memory variant + ~60 match arms) into release builds; three dialog lifecycle test fns are also ungated. Note: the speculated dead_code lint bomb did not materialize (clippy -D warnings and check --all-targets passed clean; pub items are invisible to dead_code).
findings.reproduction: new_for_tests is reachable from production code paths.
findings.suggested_fix: Gate new_for_tests, the Memory variant, MemorySettings, and arms behind cfg(test) (precedent: RiteedApp::application is cfg(any(test, feature=stress))); gate the three lifecycle fns behind cfg(test).
findings.suggested_test: Not directly testable; code-review guard.

findings.title: gtk_tests_v4..v13 family: live not legacy; naming and merge debt
findings.summary: 12 milestone-named test files (3028 lines) all run current behavior via one serial test; they cannot merge (>800 cap) but small ones (v11_git 38, v10 61, v13 108) could fold into feature-named files, and the monolithic serial test masks later flows after the first failure.
findings.reproduction: Inventory the versioned files and their exercise_* entrypoints.
findings.suggested_fix: Opportunistic renames to feature names as files are touched; fold sub-200-line version files into feature files.
findings.suggested_test: N/A (test-only; keep each file <800).

findings.title: Duplicated line_slices x3 (one divergent) and ngettext count pattern x10
findings.summary: Two byte-identical line_slices plus a same-named one with tokenize_lines semantics (the RIT-GEN-003 hazard); pluralized count formatting is reimplemented ~10 times.
findings.reproduction: Three private line_slices in one module tree; grep the ngettext/replace pattern.
findings.suggested_fix: One pub(crate) line-splitting helper per semantic (documented in the name) and one shared count_label(count, singular, plural) helper.
findings.suggested_test: Existing i18n tests cover several call sites; make the shared semantic explicit.

findings.title: README drift: V14.5-is-next and listed Format preferences page
findings.summary: README says 'V14.5 is next' (ROADMAP is next_version v15) and lists a Format preferences page removed in 0.3.7 (four pages now). Note: the originally reported missing EXTERNAL-REVIEW-HANDOFF.txt is benign per the maintainer (2026-07-06) — the prompt fable_audit_prompt.md should have carried that name; no repo file is missing.
findings.reproduction: Compare README lines 34/75 with ROADMAP frontmatter and CHANGELOG 0.3.7.
findings.suggested_fix: Fix README line 75 to v15 and line 34 to four pages without Format. The handoff filename is a prompt-naming choice and needs no repo change.
findings.suggested_test: Optional tools check crossing the README version line against ROADMAP frontmatter.

findings.title: Five dead pub functions (zero references crate-wide)
findings.summary: current_line_ending_mode, current_review_file, is_acknowledged, Document::set_saved, set_writability_for_tests each occur only at their definition; pub in pub modules hides them from dead_code.
findings.reproduction: rg -n '\b<sym>\b' --glob '*.rs' returns 1 hit each.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete; re-run the usage grep at fix time.
findings.suggested_test: N/A.

findings.title: SearchOutcome.scanned_bytes exists only to satisfy a unit test
findings.summary: scanned_bytes is written but read only inside cfg(test); the sole external consumer uses matches/reached_cap only.
findings.reproduction: rg -n scanned_bytes app/src shows only definition + test assertion.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the field and assertion, or assert via a test-local computation.
findings.suggested_test: N/A.

findings.title: ExternalFileEvent::Moved pathway unreachable in production
findings.summary: normalize_monitor_event maps every event to ContentPossiblyChanged or Missing and never constructs Moved, so the Moved arm and the rename-follow branch are dead in production (only tests inject Moved); the retained handler also fails to update state.document.source_file.
findings.reproduction: Trace normalize_monitor_event; no production construction of Moved.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete the Moved pathway, or wire other_file for Renamed/MovedOut and refresh source_file.
findings.suggested_test: N/A.

findings.title: compare_skip_reason allocates line-slice vectors just to count lines
findings.summary: line_count collects a Vec<&str> per side (up to ~1M entries at the 1MB cap) only for the limit check, then compute_diff tokenizes both texts again.
findings.reproduction: Static: line_count = line_slices(text).len().
findings.suggested_fix: Count via an iterator with similar-compatible semantics, or tokenize once and reuse; preserve lone-\r semantics.
findings.suggested_test: Existing fuzz_regression_lone_cr_line_splitting_matches_diff_ops pins the semantics.

findings.title: Micro-observations: dead clone, vestigial test, no maximized tracking, legacy CSS, documented lint suppression
findings.summary: _keep_state_alive clones an empty Vec; a test asserts accels for a nonexistent win.focus-project-sidebar; no is-maximized tracking; appearance.css:153 uses legacy @accent_bg_color; git_process.rs:172 carries the codebase's only #[allow] (documented, tracked by batch-2 Task 3).
findings.reproduction: Coordinator-verified each line.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete the dead clone and vestigial assertion; add an is-maximized key; normalize CSS syntax; drop the #[allow] via GitRunOptions.
findings.suggested_test: N/A.

findings.title: ruleset-governance required check passes vacuously for fork/dependabot PRs
findings.summary: The if: is on the step, so the required job succeeds with verification skipped for dependabot and fork-head PRs; bounded because PRs cannot change server-side rulesets and push/schedule/dispatch run it for real.
findings.reproduction: Read the step-level if condition on the required job.
findings.suggested_fix: Fail or neutralize the job explicitly rather than passing vacuously, so the required context does not falsely signal verified governance.
findings.suggested_test: N/A (workflow shape).
